description:
## [1.1.0](https://github.com/catsmoker/anime-witcher-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0) (2026-09-04)

### New Features

* **TV D-pad navigation** - fully navigable with a TV / Fire TV remote ([1823891](https://github.com/catsmoker/anime-witcher-patches/commit/1823891dd91fdc5b52012e8c33d7c0de868f71a9))
  * Content rows are made focusable so the remote can select and click them
  * D-pad presses move focus out of the top bar into the first content row (only consumed when focus actually moved)
  * All WitcherDialog dialogs are TV-focusable and install the window-callback wrapper
  * List containers watch for late-added rows
* **Android TV / Fire TV support** - manifest declarations + leanback launcher entry for HomeActivity
* **Disable VPN detection** - skip the VPN alert dialogs
* **Remove startup popup** - no more update/changelog dialog on launch
* **Play with an external player** - replaced AWPlayer with the external player option
* **Project housekeeping** - added AGENTS.md and updated .gitignore

patches.name: Android TV support
patches.description: Adds Android TV / Fire TV support (manifest declarations + TV launcher entry).

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables all ad display logic in the app.

patches.name: Disable VPN detection and alerts
patches.description: Removes VPN/DNS detection and the VPN alert dialogs.

patches.name: Play with external player
patches.description: Opens episodes in a system intent chooser so the user can pick their favorite video player (VLC, MX Player, etc.).

patches.name: Remove AppLovin initialization
patches.description: Removes AppLovin SDK initialization from the Application class.

patches.name: Remove startup popup
patches.description: Removes the update/changelog popup that appears when the app starts.

patches.name: TV D-pad navigation
patches.description: Makes the app fully navigable with a TV / Fire TV remote (focusable content rows, D-pad focus out of the top bar, dialog focus).
